title: See what's holding your product back.
text: Send us your product or website. Within 2 days you get a video walkthrough and a written audit of what stops people from signing up, sticking around or paying, in the order we would fix it.

deliverables.title: A video walkthrough
deliverables.text: We go through your product on screen and talk you through every issue we find.

deliverables.title: A written audit
deliverables.text: A prioritised list of findings with screenshots, so your team can act on it.

how.title: Send your product
how.text: A link to your site or app. For products behind a login, a test account helps.

how.title: We review it
how.text: We go through it like a new user would and note what gets in the way.

faq.q: Can you audit a mobile app?
faq.a: Yes. Send the App Store or Google Play link, or a TestFlight invite.
